summary.intent: Run load tests at 10/20/30 concurrent clients against staging, then progressively increase to find the single-instance capacity ceiling, and document baselines with Prometheus-backed upload flow analysis.
summary.outcome: Full scaling curve established (10→200 clients), first errors found at 200 clients (0.05% error rate), Kubo IPFS pinning identified as the dominant bottleneck (~95% of uploadFile latency), all results documented in the baselines doc and merged via PR #341.

repo: The load-test workflow uses GitHub environment 'staging' to scope secrets (STAGING_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET, STAGING_THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET, STAGING_API_URL); this causes the UI to show 'Deploying to staging' even though no deployment occurs.
SDK uploadFile makes 5 sequential API calls: 3x POST /ipfs/upload (ciphertext, file metadata, folder metadata) + POST /ipns/publish-batch (file IPNS) + POST /ipns/publish (folder IPNS).
Kubo IPFS pinning accounts for ~95% of uploadFile latency (~1.6s mean per pin, 3 pins per upload). IPNS publish is fast at ~141ms (DB write only, async DHT).
Single-instance capacity ceiling: ~100 clients error-free, throughput plateau at ~24-28 ops/s starting around 50 clients, first errors at 200 clients.
The 'SDK E2E Tests' job was missing from required status checks on main after CI workflow consolidation; 'Verify E2E Passed' is a separate unrelated job.
Baselines docs live in .planning/baselines/ following a numbered phase convention (e.g. 19-someguy-ipns-baselines.md).

code.finding: The 'test:single' script was using --testPathPattern which is a Jest CLI flag not recognized by Vitest. Fixed by calling 'pnpm exec vitest run --no-coverage <scenario>' directly in the workflow instead of going through the npm script.

Three bugs fixed across two PRs: (1) --testPathPattern Jest flag used instead of Vitest positional args, (2) missing 'environment: staging' caused all env vars to be empty, (3) no concurrency group meant parallel runs competed for the same staging API. Also timeout was 30min which caused cancellations when all 5 scenarios ran.

workflow: Running multiple 'gh run watch' instances simultaneously (6 watchers at 3s polling = ~120 req/min) quickly exhausts the GitHub API rate limit of 5000 req/hour.
Use 'chore(ci):' commit prefix to prevent release-please from triggering a version bump on CI-only changes.
GitHub Actions concurrency groups ('load-test-<environment>') are effective for serializing load tests against a shared staging environment.

Passing args through npm script '--' separator to Vitest doesn't work as expected — CAC puts args after '--' in a separate bucket rather than the file filter list. Always call vitest directly for scenario filtering.

friction: Initial load test runs failed due to --testPathPattern (Jest flag) and missing 'environment: staging' — required a bug-fix PR before any data could be collected.
gh run watch polling at 3s intervals across 6 concurrent watchers exhausted the GitHub API rate limit, blocking status checks for ~1 hour.
The -- separator bug in the npm test:single script caused all 5 scenarios to run instead of just the selected one, leading to 3 run cancellations due to the 30-minute timeout.
gh run watch exits early when it hits a deployment environment approval step, requiring re-watching and causing confusion about whether runs were still active.
Merge conflict in 19-someguy-ipns-baselines.md required manual resolution before PR #341 could be merged.
open_items: Fix the scenario filtering bug properly in the npm test:single script (or document that the workflow should always call vitest directly).
Analyze whether Kubo pin performance can be improved via faster storage backend, pin batching, or concurrent pins to raise the throughput ceiling.
Fill in the scaling curve with 150-client data point to better characterize the throughput plateau between 100 and 200 clients.
Investigate the 324 async DHT propagation errors (0.26% error rate) and the 17.2s mean error duration.
Consider moving staging secrets from GitHub environment scope to repository-level to avoid the misleading 'Deploying to staging' UI label.
Trigger 50 and 75-client Prometheus delta analysis was done cumulatively — per-run isolation would give cleaner per-concurrency-level server metrics.
